**PotentialBreaks 1.4.0**

- **ROLL**: one tap for a random break played a random way. **MILD** chops it on the grid, in order. **MEDIUM** may also chop on the HITS, change the loop length, shuffle the pads and move the pitch a little. **WILD** shuffles every time, can switch the tempo mode and pitches up to 7 semitones either way. RANDOM BREAK still just picks a break.
- **GRID chop now always cuts on the beat.** Before, a loop that wasn't 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars long was cut into 8 or 16 equal pieces, so the slices (and the MIDI from SAVE KIT and SAVE GROOVE) fell between the beats: a 7-bar loop gave slices 1 3/4 beats long. Now each slice is a whole number of beats (or a half or quarter beat), as many as fit on the pads: a 7-bar loop gives 14 slices of 2 beats. 1, 2, 4 and 8 bar loops are cut as before.
- The DIG panel is rearranged to fit ROLL. Two parameters were added at the end of the list (Roll, Roll Wildness); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.4.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialbreaks/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.4.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.4.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.4.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialbreaks/issues/new/choose).
